requirements.text: Students should be able to customize their timetable by color-coding modules, hiding cancelled classes, and adding study blocks.
Students should receive automatic notifications for new grades as soon as they are posted for their enrolled modules.
The module feedback system should allow students to evaluate content quality, delivery, and resources in a structured way.
The enhancements must integrate smoothly with the existing authentication system.
The current student login process should remain undisturbed.
